text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. Hey, bestie. Well, I guess I
did it,
but like...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I don't think I lived it up enough out there... Hahaha... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You wanna hear me slangmaxxing, huh?
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oof, talk about cringe! No shade to myself, but that debut was low key so cheugy! Was that even for real? Like, I can't even!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hey, girl, you totally nailed that! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but I can only do that if it's just
the two of
you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm not used to being in the spotlight.
Ryan and
McQueen have been dealing
with people's high
expectations for ages,
but me? Not so much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly being the center of everyone's
attention
just 'cause I'm making my
debut is like... major
yikes, y'know?
Hahaha...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's internally fighting an uphill battle.
Mejiro
Palmer wants to be her true party
gal self, but the
scrutinizing gazes are
weighing down on her
heavily...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Palmster! ☆ C'mon, let's take in the
blue sky
or something! ♪ We gotta pull
you out of the
dumps!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right. I won't be able to win
my
future races with an attitude like this.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Aw, girl, that's not what I meant.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You're hurting right now, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Me, hurting? Do I look that miserable?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Lemme tell you something!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I waaay prefer it when you're happy and
smiling,
like when we're hanging out,
doing whatever! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Your smile's so contagious, I always feel
happy
when I see it! ☆ Your vibes?
Straight fire! ★ Being
with you is so
fun! ♪ You're, like, the best!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You've got mad aura when you're livin' it
up and
getting hyped! So you know
what? ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I think we should roll with the punches
life swings
at us and just laugh at 'em!
That's what we
baddies gotta do to keep
slaying! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Bestie... My sun...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right. I can't be letting a
little extra
attention throw me off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta let loose and have fun. Right,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The number one thing Mejiro Palmer
needs right
now is fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna nail my next race for
sure!
Okay, what should I choose as my
next goal race?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whatever it is, I'm gonna bring the party
to the
track and run the way I want!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think for a moment. Letting her party
her heart
out on a big stage would be a
good idea, but...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Real talk, but wouldn't it be better if
you just
focused on living your truth
first, rather than
living it up at a race?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Love what you do, and you'll run better
for it. I
bet you'll start attracting fans
who like your style
too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we let Mejiro Palmer simply enjoy each
day, I
have a feeling her fanbase will
grow organically
and proportionally to
her "vibes."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why do we have to focus on
gaining fans?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My main focus will be to encourage
Mejiro Palmer
to live each day to her
fullest. We can decide how
to proceed
after seeing how that goes.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wahey-hey! ☆ Sounds like it's time for
you to
hang out with me and party hard
on Umastagram,
Palmster! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let's make you go viral so you can rack
up those
followers! How's 10,000 sound
for starters?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
10,000? Hm, it would be pretty great if
I could
actually gain that many fans just
by goofing
around, running, and living it
up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right! You know what they say! Work
hard,
play hard! I'm gonna party hard
and race just as
hard!

text_block_list.name: Palmer and Helios
text_block_list.text: Wahey-heeey! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she's to run free, her mind and heart
also has to
be free. As a way to roughly
measure that
freedom, we decide her
goal is to gain at least
9,000 fans.
